en.headline: CFS finds no excessive lead in over 50 infant formula samples
en.dek: All samples tested between 25 and 28 July, including 11 batches of one brand previously linked to a Macau alert, met Hong Kong’s legal limit of 0.01 mg per kg.
body: The Centre for Food Safety said on 29 July that it had sampled more than 50 infant and young-child formula products from the market between 25 and 28 July and tested them for lead content. None of the samples exceeded Hong Kong’s statutory limit of 0.01 milligram per kilogram.

The testing included 11 batches of Royal Frisolac Gold 1 (800 g). The centre continues to follow up a Macau authority alert concerning one specific batch of that product (best before 30 September 2027, batch 1W07KPJ). Officers have inspected retail outlets to confirm the batch has been removed from sale, and the importer is conducting a recall. Members of the public may call 2280 4731 during office hours for recall details.

A CFS spokesman reiterated that long-term excessive lead intake can affect the nervous system and brain development of children. The public is advised not to feed the affected batch to infants and to seek medical attention if any symptoms appear after consumption. Industry operators should stop using or selling the batch immediately.

From 2023 to July 2026 the centre has tested more than 2,200 infant-formula samples for chemical and microbiological parameters, including lead, with no exceedances recorded. Sampling and monitoring will continue.

zh.headline: 食安中心抽檢逾50個嬰幼兒奶粉樣本全部鉛含量合格
zh.dek: 7月25至28日抽取的樣本（包括11個曾與澳門通報有關的品牌批次）鉛含量均未超出本港法定上限每公斤0.01毫克。
body: 食物環境衞生署食物安全中心7月29日表示，已於7月25至28日在市面抽取超過50個嬰幼兒配方奶粉樣本進行鉛含量檢測，全部樣本均未超出本港法定標準（每公斤不超出0.01毫克）。
檢測包括11個皇家美素力1號（800克）批次。中心持續跟進澳門當局早前公布的一批嬰兒配方奶粉鉛含量超出標準個案，涉及的受影響批次（最佳食用日期2027年9月30日前、批次1W07KPJ）已獲巡查零售點確認下架，進口商正進行回收。市民可於辦公時間致電2280 4731查詢回收事宜。
中心發言人強調，兒童長期過量攝入鉛可導致神經系統受損及影響腦部發育，呼籲市民不要讓嬰幼兒食用受影響批次產品，如有不適應盡快求醫。業界應立即停止使用或出售該批次。
由2023年至2026年7月，中心已抽檢超過2,200個嬰幼兒配方奶粉樣本，涵蓋化學及微生物檢測包括鉛含量，並無超標個案。中心會繼續抽檢及密切監察。
